query: SELECT COALESCE(sc.is_first_time_streamer, FALSE) AS "is_first_time_streamer!" FROM twitch_session_chatters sc JOIN twitch_stream_sessions ss ON ss.id = sc.session_id WHERE LOWER(sc.streamer_login) = $1 AND LOWER(sc.chatter_login) = $2 AND ss.ended_at IS NULL ORDER BY ss.started_at DESC LIMIT 1
